name: Banco BBVA Argentina S.A.
summary: Banco BBVA Argentina S.A. provides banking products and services in Argentina. The company offers retail banking products and services, such as checking and savings accounts, time deposits, credit card financing, consumer and pledge loans, mortgages, insurance, and investment products to individuals; and financing products, factoring, checking accounts, time deposits, transactional and payroll services, insurance, and investment products to private-sector companies and small and medium-sized enterprises. It also provides corporate and investment banking products and services, including global transaction services; global markets solutions comprising risk management and securities brokerage; …
